//: The deno config every browser bundle in this repository is built with. Maps the same package specifiers the root deno.json does, plus the non-browser FFI host imports (node:*, bun:ffi) to browser stubs, so the stack's node/bun adapters — bundled but never selected once the web adapter is injected — resolve without pulling a runtime the browser lacks. That stub table tracks which built-ins the stack's adapter cascade imports, so it has one owner and is not copied per surface; a browser app that needs more specifiers adds them here rather than forking it, which is why React (the rooms page's UI runtime, pinned to the version apps/rooms/web/ui/deno.json type-checks against) is mapped below and the JSX transform is configured here. A bundle whose entry contains no JSX is unaffected by either. Use with `deno bundle --platform browser --config bindings/ts/web/browser-bundle.json <entry>`.
